categories.main_business_segments: Pool Corporation operates as the world’s largest wholesale distributor of swimming pool supplies, equipment, and related leisure products, and is also a leading distributor of irrigation and landscape maintenance products in the United States. The company’s operations are organized through five primary distribution networks: SCP Distributors, Superior Pool Products, Horizon Distributors, National Pool Tile (NPT), and Sun Wholesale Supply. These networks serve both residential and commercial markets, including pool builders, specialty retailers, service companies, and landscape contractors. The company’s product offerings span maintenance, repair, construction, and renovation of pools, as well as irrigation and outdoor living products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: POOL leverages advanced distribution technologies, including business-to-business (B2B) digital platforms such as POOL360 and Horizon 24/7, which integrate e-commerce, software applications, and data-driven insights to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency. The company utilizes warehouse management systems, velocity slotting, and mobile ordering platforms to optimize inventory, order processing, and delivery. It also invests in digital transformation initiatives, including mobile apps for water testing and backyard design, and offers a growing selection of energy-efficient and environmentally friendly products, such as variable speed pumps and LED lighting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: POOL serves approximately 125,000 customers, primarily small, family-owned businesses such as swimming pool remodelers and builders, specialty retailers (including Pinch A Penny franchise stores), pool repair and service companies, irrigation and landscape contractors, and commercial pool operators (e.g., hotels, universities, community facilities). The majority of sales are to the residential market, but the company is expanding its presence in the commercial pool segment. End markets include maintenance and repair, pool construction, renovation, and outdoor living enhancements.
categories.geographic_coverage: POOL operates 448 sales centers across North America, Europe, and Australia. Its primary markets are in the United States, with Florida, California, Texas, and Arizona accounting for about 54% of 2024 net sales. Approximately 96% of sales are generated in North America (including Canada and Mexico), 4% in Europe, and less than 1% in Australia. The company continues to expand both domestically and internationally, but expects the geographic mix to remain similar in the near term.
categories.supply_chain_position: POOL operates as a downstream distributor, purchasing products from a large number of manufacturers and efficiently distributing them to a fragmented customer base. The company adds value by aggregating products, offering favorable purchasing terms, and providing high levels of service and support to its customers. It maintains well-stocked inventories at local sales centers and utilizes centralized shipping locations for regional redistribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: POOL’s strategic priorities include promoting industry and customer growth, expanding product offerings (especially proprietary and exclusive brands), and continuously improving operational effectiveness through technology and digital transformation. The company invests in digital tools, e-commerce, and data-driven platforms to enhance customer productivity and experience. It also focuses on sustainability, offering energy-efficient and environmentally friendly products, and seeks growth through new sales center openings, acquisitions, and expansion into new product categories and markets.
categories.revenue_model: POOL generates revenue primarily through the wholesale distribution of swimming pool, irrigation, landscape, and outdoor living products. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, either at point-of-sale or upon delivery. The company also benefits from vendor incentives and proprietary product sales. Its revenue streams are diversified across maintenance and repair (recurring), renovation and upgrade, and new construction (more discretionary).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: POOL is the largest wholesale distributor in its industry and one of the only national distributors focused on the swimming pool market in the U.S. It faces intense competition from regional and local distributors, a limited number of other national distributors, mass market retailers (store-based and online), and large pool supply retailers who may buy directly from manufacturers. Barriers to entry are relatively low, and competition is especially concentrated in high pool-density states. POOL’s competitive advantages include breadth of product offering, service quality, geographic reach, and digital capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, POOL reported net sales of $5.3 billion, a 4% decrease from 2023, with net income of $434 million and diluted EPS of $11.30. The company experienced stable maintenance-related revenues but softer sales in discretionary categories due to macroeconomic headwinds. POOL maintains strong cash flow, with $659 million provided by operations in 2024, and continues to invest in growth through new locations and acquisitions. While recent growth has moderated following pandemic-driven surges, the company expects long-term growth opportunities driven by demographic trends, housing dynamics, and product innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: POOL emphasizes exceptional value through the broadest product assortment, high service levels, and convenient, locally-stocked sales centers. Its digital platforms and technology investments enhance customer productivity and experience, while proprietary and exclusive brands offer differentiated products. The company’s focus on sustainability, energy efficiency, and comprehensive support programs (including training, marketing, and business development tools) further distinguish it from competitors and foster long-term customer loyalty.
